title: Mountains, Waters and Sesshin, Part 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett reflects on their teacher Norman's approach to Zen practice, which emphasized simplicity, humility, and trust in the process. This approach encouraged students to let go of conceptual thinking and instead focus on being present and doing their best with what they already had, creating a relaxed yet serious atmosphere for learning and growth. By embracing this perspective, students can awaken to their true nature and continue the Buddha's way, mirroring the responsibility that lies within each individual.
